story_title: As a Safety Officer, I want to review an event's operational safety and record my decision so that only events with safe arrangements proceed

acceptance_criteria.text: The Safety Officer can view a list of events awaiting an Operational Safety Check, earliest event date first.

For each event, the review shows expected attendance, each venue booking with its capacity and layout, accessibility requirements, equipment arrangements, and any recorded venue restrictions or unavailable periods.
The Safety Officer can approve the event.
The Safety Officer can reject the safety arrangement, and must give a reason.
The Safety Officer can request changes, and must describe the changes required.
Given the Safety Officer attempts to reject or request changes without a reason, when they submit, then the decision is not saved and a reason is asked for.
Approving records the event as safety-approved and returns it to the Coordinator to proceed.
Rejecting or requesting changes returns the event to Planning (see: Resolve Safety Check Outcome).
The assigned Event Coordinator is notified of the decision, with the reason or the changes required.
The decision, the Safety Officer who made it, and the date and time are recorded against the event.
A decision can only be recorded for an event in Safety Review, and only once per submission.
Only a Safety Officer can record a safety decision.

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-13: AC1's order is the event's start date, earliest first. SPM-85's Safety Checks list sorted by oldest submission; SPM-87 changes that sort (Jordan's api/safety-checks, owner told).

RESOLVED 2026-10-13: Approving moves the event to a new status 'Safety approved' (stored as safety_cleared, since safety_approved is already the Readiness tab's safety-check badge key), which is what AC7's 'records the event as safety-approved' means. From Safety approved the Coordinator confirms (Safety approved -> Confirmed is allowed from SPM-87), or a significant change returns it to Planning (SPM-88). Rejecting or requesting changes returns it to Planning (AC8). Lifecycle diagram to be updated.

RESOLVED 2026-10-13: There is no separate review page. The Safety Officer opens the event from the Safety Checks list (SPM-85), whose Overview and Equipment tabs already show attendance, sessions, each booking's layout and seats, accessibility and equipment (SPM-85 AC3). SPM-87 adds AC2's missing part - each booked venue's opening hours and its unavailable periods on the event's dates - to SPM-85's 'Venue bookings' card, and the decision itself as a 'Record safety decision' button on the Overview.
RESOLVED 2026-10-13: 'Recorded venue restrictions' are the venue's opening hours and its unavailable periods (SPM-45) on the event's dates; the venue has no other restrictions field.
RESOLVED 2026-10-13: A reason is required for Reject and Request changes (not blank, at most 1,000 characters); none for Approve (TC08).

RESOLVED 2026-10-13: AC9 saves a notification for the assigned coordinator with the decision and the reason or changes. It can only be opened once SPM-71 builds Notifications, so TC12 is Blocked; meanwhile the decision and reason show on the event's 'Safety check' row (TC04, TC06, TC07). The reason is shown to internal users only (SPM-88 AC10) - the Organiser sees the status (TC05).
RESOLVED 2026-10-13: Only the Safety Officer (permission event:safety_check, SPM-85) records a decision (AC12, TC11).

DECIDED 2026-10-13: Wording - button 'Record safety decision'; dialog 'Record safety decision' with the choices 'Approve', 'Request changes', 'Reject'; box 'Changes required' or 'Reason for rejecting' (none for Approve); button 'Record decision' / 'Cancel'. Messages: 'Safety check approved. The coordinator has been notified.'; 'Changes requested. The event is back in Planning and the coordinator has been notified.'; 'Safety arrangement rejected. The event is back in Planning and the coordinator has been notified.'; 'Give a reason for rejecting.'; 'Describe the changes required.'; 'This safety check has already been decided.'. Safety check row: '<Approved | Changes requested | Rejected> · decided by <name>, <date and time>', followed by '. Changes required: …' or '. Reason: …'. Notification titles: 'Safety check: approved' / 'Safety check: changes requested' / 'Safety check: rejected'. Venue bookings card: opening hours '08:00–22:00' and 'Unavailable <date>, <from>–<to> (<reason>)'.

DECIDED 2026-10-13: 'Safety approved' badge (status safety_cleared) is added wherever Safety review was: a 'Safety approved' list on the organiser's and coordinator's Dashboard after 'Safety review', Venue Staff and Technical Support 'Upcoming events', the status filter, Technical Support's equipment view, and reassigning the coordinator.

DECIDED 2026-10-13: Fixtures (scripts/seed-spm87.ts, npm run fixtures:spm87) - a dedicated venue 'SPM87 Hillside Studio' (SPM87-STU, Theatre seats 60, open 08:00-22:00, maintenance 8 Oct 2027 07:00-09:00) so no other venue gains an unavailable period; events in Safety review, each with a pending SafetyCheck submitted by Daniel Tan in reverse date order, an approved booking and a reserved Handheld Wireless Mic: 'SPM87 Hillside Workshop' (8 Oct 2027 10:00-13:00, 50 people, at SPM87 Hillside Studio, accessibility notes), 'SPM87 Lakeside Conference' (12 Oct), 'SPM87 Waterfront Gala' (18 Oct), 'SPM87 Rooftop Launch Party' (20 Oct, 300 people), 'SPM87 Twin Tab Briefing' (22 Oct); and 'SPM87 Unsubmitted Planning Day' in Planning. Organiser Rachel Ng, coordinator Daniel Tan.

RESOLVED 2026-10-13: A view of checks already decided (Approved / Returned tabs on Safety Checks) is not in SPM-87's criteria. It was built, then taken out of SPM-87 to keep the story to its criteria; to be raised with the PO as a backlog story.
